response.body: The segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment must be provided, and its effectiveness must be recorded as a critical control verification before the task proceeds. The light vehicle exclusion radius from operating haul trucks must be set at 30 m. This clause applies to activities archived under MOBILE-EQUIPMENT-INTERACTION at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop.
